'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least thirteen people are killed and dozens others are missing as [[Typhoon Bualoi (2025)|Typhoon Bualoi]] makes landfall in [[Nghệ An province|Nghệ An]] and [[Hà Tĩnh province]]s, [[Vietnam]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/typhoon-bualoi-lashes-vietnam-killing-at-least-13/a-74168704 (DW)]
*Twelve people are killed and 42 injured in three separate road accidents in [[Panjgur District|Panjgur]], [[Pishin District|Pishin]] and [[Lasbela District|Lasbela]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1945111/12-killed-42-injured-in-balochistan-accidents (Dawn)]
*Four people are killed and another six people affected after a fire in a building in [[Lebanon, Pennsylvania]], United States. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/4-dead-2-young-children-a-teen-and-an-adult-after-lebanon-city-duplex-fire/ar-AA1NtK9l?ocid=BingNewsSerp (MSN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[Grand Blanc Township church attack]]
***Four people are killed and eight others are injured in a mass shooting and [[arson]] attack on a [[Mormon]] church in [[Grand Blanc, Michigan|Grand Blanc]], [[Michigan]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator is killed in a [[shootout]] with police. [https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/church-shooting-fire-michigan-09-28-25?t=1759105712125 (CNN)] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/09/shooting-with-multiple-victims-at-mormon-church-in-grand-blanc-michigan/ (BNO News)]
**Two people are killed and five others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[casino]] on the [[Kickapoo Traditional Tribe of Texas|Kickapoo reservation]] near [[Eagle Pass, Texas]], United States. The suspect initially fled the scene before being taken into custody. [https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/one-dead-at-least-six-injured-in-shooting-at-lucky-eagle-casino (WOAI-TV)] [https://www.ksat.com/news/local/2025/09/28/2-killed-several-injured-in-shooting-at-kickapoo-lucky-eagle-casino-maverick-county-judge-says/ (KSAT-TV)]
*[[2025 Danish drone incidents]]
**The [[government of Denmark]] bans all [[civilian]] [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]] after several UAVs were seen above [[Danish Armed Forces|military]] sites last week and caused several [[List of airports in Denmark|airports]] to temporarily close in fear of an [[drone warfare|attack]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/denmark-bans-civil-drones-after-more-sightings/a-74166973 (DW)]
*[[Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping]]
**Former [[China|Chinese]] [[Minister of Agriculture and Rural Affairs|agriculture minister]] [[Tang Renjian]] is [[Capital punishment in China|sentenced to death]] with a [[Death sentence with reprieve|two-year reprieve]] for [[Corruption in China|accepting bribes]] worth more than [[Renminbi|¥]]268 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]37.6 million) between 2007 and 2024. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-former-minister-agriculture-sentenced-death-with-reprieve-bribery-case-2025-09-28/ (Reuters)]
*A civilian is killed and twelve [[Armed Forces of Ecuador|soldiers]] are injured during clashes between security forces and [[Indigenous peoples in Ecuador|Indigenous]] protesters in [[Cayambe, Ecuador|Cayambe]], [[Pichincha Province|Pichincha]], [[Ecuador]], over [[Government of Ecuador|the government]]’s decision to end a [[Energy policy of Ecuador|diesel fuel]] [[subsidy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-protests-diesel-subsidy-indigenous-people-noboa-ec78506430132f8b381dc6363302c1ef (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Moldovan parliamentary election]]
**[[Moldovans]] vote to elect the 101 seats of the [[Parliament of Moldova|parliament]]. [https://apnews.com/article/moldova-election-parliament-russia-hybrid-war-8a3ae659c1d8bf8499ac130e8054fb35 (AP)]
**The pro-[[European Union|EU]] [[Party of Action and Solidarity]] of [[President of Moldova|Moldovan president]] [[Maia Sandu]] wins with 50.2% of the vote, while the [[left-wing politics|left-wing]] [[Russophilia|pro-Russian]] [[Patriotic Electoral Bloc]] wins 24.2% and the [[Alternative (political bloc)|Alternative]] alliance wins 8%. Voter turnout is reportedly over 52.2%, higher than [[Elections in Moldova|previous elections]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2rdlj8ejgo (BBC News)]
*[[2025 Swiss referendums]]
**Switzerland approves two referendums to decide on electronic identity and property tax. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/28/swiss-voters-back-electronic-identity-cards-in-close-vote (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 Asia Cup]]
**In [[cricket]], [[India national cricket team|India]] defeat [[India–Pakistan cricket rivalry|their rival]] [[Pakistan national cricket team|Pakistan]] by five [[wicket]]s in [[2025 Asia Cup final|the final]] to win their second consecutive [[Asia Cup]] title and ninth overall. During the awarding ceremony, the Indian team refused to accept their trophy from [[Asian Cricket Council]] chairperson and [[Pakistan]]i [[Ministry of Interior (Pakistan)|interior minister]] [[Mohsin Naqvi]] due to the [[Indo-Pakistani wars and conflicts|political turmoil]] between both nations. [https://apnews.com/article/india-pakistan-asia-cup-final-cricket-handshake-1988bf969bd605a5b35db8bd8f436e12 (AP)]

*[[2025 Ryder Cup]]
**In [[golf]], Team Europe retains the [[Ryder Cup]] after scoring 15–13 over the [[Golf in the United States|United States]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/golf/ryder-cup-2025-live-scores-today-tee-times-europe-usa-b2835118.html (''The Independent'')]
